from pathlib import Path
import json,hashlib,subprocess,sys,time,os
pack=Path('/workspace/cocolon_adaptive30_pack_20261027'); began=time.monotonic()
consumer=pack/'consume_adaptive30.py'; records=[]
cmd=[sys.executable,'-B',str(consumer),'--run',str(pack),'--validate-inputs-only']
r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=120,check=True);records.append(dict(kind='inputs15',command=cmd,returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr))
for cid in ['TRAIN-SERVICE-CHAIR-01-CORRECTION','FT-SHOP-INITIAL','FT-REPOT-INITIAL']:
 source=Path('/workspace/cocolon_localized30_diagnosis_20261027')/(cid+'_saved.json')
 before=hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest();out=pack/(cid+'_consumer_smoke.json')
 cmd=[sys.executable,'-B',str(consumer),'--worker','--run',str(pack),'--saved-input',str(source),'--expected-saved-sha256',before,'--worker-output',str(out)]
 r=subprocess.run(cmd,capture_output=True,text=True,timeout=60,check=True)
 assert hashlib.sha256(source.read_bytes()).hexdigest()==before
 d=json.loads(out.read_text());records.append(dict(kind='existing_saved_not_new_model',case_id=cid,command=cmd,source_sha256=before,output_sha256=hashlib.sha256(out.read_bytes()).hexdigest(),status=d['status'],returncode=r.returncode,stdout=r.stdout,stderr=r.stderr))
result=dict(status='INPUTS15_AND_EXISTING_SAVED_COLD3_VERIFIED',seconds=time.monotonic()-began,records=records,model_loads=0,model_forwards=0,updates=0,generations=0,sql_operations=0,new_model_quality_credit=0,automatic_progression=False)
(pack/'consumer_cpu_check.json').write_text(json.dumps(result,ensure_ascii=False,indent=2))
print(result['status'],result['seconds'])
